changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kid_view AS SELECT k.id AS id, k.dtype AS dtype, k.first_name AS first_name, k.last_name AS last_name, k.birth_date AS birth_date, k.color_of_shirt AS color_of_shirt, k.color_of_dress AS color_of_dress, COUNT(g.id) AS gift_count FROM kid k LEFT JOIN gift g ON g.kid_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id
